battle.name: 征服帕米拉王國
battle.brief: 公元272年，羅馬皇帝奧勒良集結野戰軍東征，在安條克以南的伊邁擊潰澤諾比婭的帕米拉騎軍，再追過沙漠直逼帕米拉。守軍自行打開城門，羅軍步兵以大盾配羅馬短劍在近身戰中刺倒守軍；其後奧勒良處死開城主將、縱兵劫掠、焚燒城區。澤諾比婭在幼發拉底河畔被擒，押往安條克，帕米拉王國覆亡。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 交戰方是羅馬帝國與帕米拉王國。帕米拉王國又譯泰瑪利亞王國，是西元260年前後在敘利亞沙漠腹地的綠洲城帕米拉建立的阿拉伯人政權，創建者為塞普蒂米烏斯·奧德納圖斯與其妻澤諾比婭。這個政權形式上仍向羅馬皇帝稱臣，實質上以徵收商路關稅、掌握稅權與獨立軍隊的方式自成強權，疆域由安條克南面直抵阿爾勒法與幼發拉底河中游，控制羅馬通往波斯與印度的陸路樞紐。羅馬一方是皇帝奧勒良在位時的帝國中央軍：西元270年至271年間他先後自萊茵、多瑙河與西西里抽調兵力，於安條克一帶集結野戰軍，步兵包含駐敘利亞的第III加利卡、第VI費拉塔等帝國軍團與新編的野戰軍，另有禁衛重裝步兵「Cornuti」、數百人的具裝騎兵團，以及各類弓手與矛兵；羅軍指揮體系高度集中於皇帝本人與少數禁軍將官，糧秣靠海路與安條克、卡爾基斯一線的基地逐段供應。帕米拉方面則由女王澤諾比婭直接統軍，兵源包括沙漠貝都因部落兵、希臘化城鎮徵召兵、奴隸兵與重裝騎兵，統兵權交在安條克出身的希臘裔將領手上；薩珊波斯是它名義上的後盾，但援軍從未真正成軍。
countriesEn: The belligerents were the Roman Empire and the Kingdom of Palmyra. The Palmyrene state, also called the Realm of Tadmor, was an Arab polity founded around AD 260 in the oasis city of Palmyra in the belly of the Syrian desert by Septimius Odaenathus and his wife Zenobia. Nominally it remained a client of the Roman emperor, but in practice it ruled itself, taxing the caravan trade and keeping its own army and its own revenue; its territory reached from south of Antioch to the Araxes and the middle Euphrates, holding the land bridge that carried Roman trade with Persia and India. On the Roman side stood the imperial field army of the emperor Aurelian: between AD 270 and 271 he shifted troops back from the Rhine, the Danube and Sicily and concentrated a field army around Antioch, with infantry drawn from the Syrian-based legions III Gallica and VI Ferrata together with newly raised limitanei and comitatenses, protected by the armoured infantry of the Cornuti, several hundred riders in heavy armour, and a spread of archers and spear troops. Roman command was tightly centralised on the emperor himself and a handful of praetorian officers, and grain was supplied by sea and by a chain of bases running through Antioch and Chalcis. On the Palmyrene side the army was commanded in person by Queen Zenobia, raised from desert Bedouin clans, Hellenised town levies, slaves and heavy cavalry, and the field command was held by officers of Greek origin from Antioch. Sasanian Persia was the nominal sponsor of the state, but no relief army ever actually materialised.
people: 全役的核心人物是三人。奧勒良（Aurelian，約215年至275年），綽號「世界重建者」，西元270年即位時正被澤諾比婭逐出安條克，他用兩年重新集結帝國野戰軍，於272年春反攻，在伊邁擊敗對手後把整支大軍拖過沙漠直取帕米拉本城；入城後他處死開城門的守軍首領、准許短期的劫掠、再下令焚燒城區，卻又在同年把瓦巴拉特召回。西元275年他在君士坦丁堡附近遇刺身亡。澤諾比婭（Aelia Zenobia，約240年至272或273年），出身帕米拉一個家世並不顯赫的阿拉伯裔家庭，前夫奧德納圖斯被暗殺後她以攝政身份掌握兵權，扶持幼子瓦巴拉特於271年稱奧古斯都，隨後把兒子也除掉而自行稱帝；她能親自上馬、能以一紙回信駁斥皇帝，是古代極少數留下錢幣正面的女性君主。她的兒子瓦巴拉特（Vaballathus）在275年一度復位，次年被奧勒良在羅馬處決。此外，帕米拉守軍的首領塞普蒂米烏斯（Septimius，古代史料僅留下名字）在守軍不願再受女王專斷、擅自與羅軍議和時主導開門投降，事後與其子一同被處死。塞維魯王朝留下的《奧勒良傳》是本役細節的主要來源，其作者對奧勒良多有掩飾，對澤諾比婭則多有醜化，兩者都需與錢幣、銘文對照。
peopleEn: Three people dominate the campaign. Aurelian (c. 215-275), styled Restitutor Orbis, had taken the throne in AD 270 while being driven out of Antioch by Zenobia; he spent two years rebuilding the imperial field army, counter-attacked in the spring of 272, beat her at Immae, and then dragged the whole army across the desert to strike Palmyra itself. Once inside the walls he executed the commander who had opened the gates, allowed a short sack, and finally ordered the city burned, yet in the same year he recalled Vaballathus. He was assassinated near Byzantium in AD 275. Zenobia (Aelia Zenobia, c. 240-c. 272 or 273) came from a family of modest Arab standing in Palmyra; after the murder of her husband Odaenathus she took power as regent, ruled through her young son Vaballathus, who was made Augustus in 271, and then had him removed and assumed the imperial title herself. She rode in person, she answered an emperor in writing, and she is one of the very few ancient women whose portrait survives on her own coinage. Her son Vaballathus briefly resurfaced in 275 and was executed by Aurelian in Rome the following year. Also decisive was Septimius, the commander of the Palmyrene garrison, whose name alone the ancient sources preserve: when the garrison, unwilling to go on obeying the queen's personal command, opened negotiations with the Romans, it was he who opened the gates, and he and his son were afterwards executed. The Historia Augusta of the Severan dynasty is the main source for the detail of this campaign; its author shields Aurelian and vilifies Zenobia, so both portraits must be checked against coinage and inscriptions.
kits: 卡面兵器羅馬短劍（gladius）在西元272年仍是帝國軍團步兵的標準側身武器：葉形雙刃劍身約五十公分，寬約四公分，兼顧刺與斬，劍身中央起脊，護手不發達，攻守全靠握法控制距離；步兵同時配備橢圓大盾（scutum）與分節鎖子甲或鱗甲。戰役中短劍的位置有三處：一是伊邁與卡爾基斯兩役的近身階段，帕米拉裝甲重騎（cataphracts）逼近時，羅軍步兵以盾牆頂住衝力，再順著盾牌邊緣把短劍刺入馬腿與騎士膝上；二是追擊與合圍中的野戰近身；三是入城後在狹窄街道與屋舍之間的巷戰，這種距離上短劍比任何長柄兵器都靈活。帕米拉方面的裝備以沙漠戰為本位：步兵用長矛、雙刃直刀與彎刀，射手配弓與標槍，另有投石索；精銳是披甲的裝甲重騎與女王的近衛騎兵，澤諾比婭本人乘雙輪戰車出陣。攻城方面，帕米拉城牆周長約三點五公里、平面近方形、四角與城門皆有望樓，東門為雙層巨門，城內有長約一公里的柱廊大街、貝爾神廟與集市；由於守軍開門投降，羅軍幾乎沒有使用攻城塔、撞柱與坑道，只需在入城後以火把焚燒城區。運輸與補給才是羅軍真正的難題：駱駝商隊是帕米拉的命脈，而羅軍在荒漠中的水源與草料全靠幼發拉底河上游及阿斯河沿岸的基地逐段接應。
kitsEn: The card weapon, the Roman gladius, was still in AD 272 the standard sidearm of the imperial legionary: a leaf-shaped double-edged blade about fifty centimetres long and four centimetres wide, edged for both thrust and cut, ridged down the centre, with no developed cross-guard, so that the manner of gripping it sets the fighting distance. It was carried together with the large oval scutum and either segmented lorica or scale armour. The gladius had three roles in this campaign. First, in the close phase of the fighting at Immae and Chalcis, when the Palmyrene cataphracts closed in: the Roman infantry braced behind the shield wall, absorbed the shock and then drove the short sword forward along the rim of the shield into the legs of the horses and the knees of their riders. Second, in the melee of pursuit and encirclement during the pursuit. Third, in the street fighting that followed the entry into the city, where a short blade was far more workable than any polearm in a narrow lane. Palmyrene equipment was built for the desert: infantry with long spears, straight double-edged swords and curved blades, archers and javelin-throwers, and slingers; the elite was the armoured cataphract cavalry and the queen's own bodyguard of riders, and Zenobia herself went out in a two-wheeled chariot. For siege works, Palmyra's wall ran about three and a half kilometres in an almost square circuit with towers at the corners and at the gates, the eastern gate carrying a double storey, and inside the town stood a colonnaded street roughly a kilometre long, the temple of Bel and the market place. Because the garrison opened the gates, the Romans hardly needed towers, battering rams or mines; after the entry they only had to fire the city with torches. Logistics, not siegecraft, were the real difficulty for the Roman army: the camel caravans were the life of Palmyra, while the water and fodder of the desert campaign had to be chained forward stage by stage from bases on the upper Euphrates and the Araxes.
tactics: 奧勒良的戰術可以歸納成四個要點。第一是集中與速度：他不在敘利亞、埃及、阿拉伯三條戰線上分散兵力，而是一次帶走大批野戰軍與輔助騎兵，邊行軍邊作戰，目標直指對方的政治中心。第二是騎兵決戰：伊邁之戰中，羅軍以具裝與輕重混編的騎兵正面迎擊帕米拉裝甲重騎，同時步兵方陣穩住中央，帕米拉騎兵在兩面受壓下先行潰散，澤諾比婭乘戰車逃走，羅軍攻佔其營地與輜重。第三是追擊與逼城：卡爾基斯之役後，澤諾比婭丟下大部分車隊單騎衝入沙漠，躲入帕米拉；羅軍進抵城下卻避免長期圍困，把騎兵留作偵察與追擊，步兵封住通往城外的道路。第四是攻心與接管：奧勒良先致書勸降、澤諾比婭回書駁斥，雙方書信保存於《奧勒良傳》；兵臨城下時，守軍因不願再由女王獨斷而自行開門，羅軍入城後控制城門與要道，殺害羅軍俘虜的守軍首領與其子被處死，接著奧勒良給出短期限度的劫掠，最終下令拆毀城牆、焚燒城區，只留柱廊街與神廟的地基。帕米拉守軍的戰術則以避免野戰、保存實力為主：沙漠游騎騷擾商道、以城牆與井水為核心抵抗，最後仍因內部指揮權之爭而崩解。
tacticsEn: Aurelian's tactical method can be reduced to four points. First, concentration and speed: rather than spreading himself across the Syrian, Egyptian and Arabian fronts, he took a single mass of field army and auxiliary cavalry, fought as he marched, and aimed straight at the political centre of the enemy state. Second, decision by cavalry: at Immae the Roman mounted troops, armoured and light mixed, met the Palmyrene cataphracts head on while the infantry square steadied the centre; the Palmyrene horse broke first under pressure on two sides, Zenobia escaped in her chariot, and the Romans took her camp and baggage. Third, pursuit and investment: after Chalcis she abandoned most of her baggage train and rode alone into the desert to reach Palmyra; the Romans came up to the walls without settling into a long blockade, keeping the horse for scouting and pursuit while infantry closed the roads out of the city. Fourth, war of nerves and takeover: Aurelian first wrote urging surrender, Zenobia wrote back refuting him, and both letters survive in the Historia Augusta; once the army stood below the walls the garrison, unwilling to go on taking orders from the queen alone, opened the gates by itself. The Romans took the gates and the main streets, the commander who had killed Roman prisoners and his son were executed, Aurelian then allowed a short and bounded sack, and in the end ordered the walls pulled down and the city fired, leaving only the substructures of the colonnaded street and the temples. Palmyra's own tactical logic was to avoid pitched battle and preserve its strength: desert riders harried the caravans, the wall and the wells were the core of the defence, and the command itself finally broke apart over who was entitled to decide.
data: 可查證的數字集中在幾處。地理上，帕米拉位於敘利亞沙漠腹地，約在北緯三十四點四五度、東經三十八點二七分，離安條克約五百公里以上的陸路，沿途大半是無水的石灰岩荒漠；羅軍自安條克出發到兵臨城下，歷時約兩到三個月。城池方面，帕米拉城牆周長約三點五公里，平面近方形，四角與城門皆有望樓，東門為雙層巨門，柱廊大街長約一公里，是羅馬東方最長的柱廊街之一。軍隊規模方面，古代記載多以「萬計」形容澤諾比婭的軍隊，可靠數字並不存在；羅馬方面是一支由多個帝國軍團、輔助騎兵團與弓兵混成的野戰軍，總數在數萬之譜，具體編制沒有留下可信記錄。錢幣提供最硬的物證：澤諾比婭曾以自己名義鑄幣，幣面為她戴冠冕的頭像與「SALVBS REIPVBLICAE」字樣；奧勒良在征服後發行「CONQ PALMYR」與「PALMYRENAE」兩種紀念幣，其中一枚把帕米拉人刻成跪著的俘虜，是羅馬把這場勝利鑄進貨幣的罕見例子。時間上，戰役主要發生於272年春至夏（月份欄位屬依戰線推填，非文獻記載），澤諾比婭在272或273年間死於安條克，帕米拉被焚與瓦巴拉特被處決多繫於273年，戴克里先於274年重建帕米拉。史料方面，細節主要出自四世紀寫成的《奧勒良傳》，其敘事戲劇化、數字可疑，須與錢幣、銘文與考古遺址互相對照。
dataEn: The figures that can actually be checked fall into several groups. Geographically, Palmyra lies in the heart of the Syrian desert at about 34.45 degrees north and 38.27 degrees east, some five hundred kilometres or more of land travel from Antioch, most of it waterless limestone waste; the Roman army needed roughly two to three months to go from Antioch to the walls. On the town itself, the circuit of the walls runs about three and a half kilometres in an almost square plan with towers at the corners and at the gates, the eastern gate carrying a double storey, and the colonnaded main street is about a kilometre long, among the longest colonnades of the Roman East. On the size of the armies, the ancient writers habitually speak of the Palmyrene force in units of ten thousands, and no dependable figure survives; the Roman side was a field army mixed from several imperial legions, auxiliary cavalry units and archers, certainly in the tens of thousands, but its exact composition is not recorded in any trustworthy source. Coinage gives the hardest physical evidence: Zenobia struck money in her own name, showing her diademed bust with the legend SALVBS REIPVBLICAE, and after the conquest Aurelian issued two commemorative types, CONQ PALMYR and PALMYRENAE, one of which depicts a kneeling captive Palmyrene, a rare case of Rome casting a victory into its currency. On chronology, the fighting ran from the spring to the summer of 272 (the month field is an inference from that spring-to-summer dating, not a documented fact); Zenobia died at Antioch in 272 or 273; the burning of Palmyra and the execution of Vaballathus are usually placed in 273; and Diocletian rebuilt Palmyra in 274. On sources, nearly all the detail comes from the Historia Augusta, written in the fourth century, whose narrative is dramatic and whose numbers are doubtful, and which has to be cross-checked against coins, inscriptions and excavated remains.
cause: 打起來的原因有遠有近。遠因是西元259年至270年間羅馬陷入「三十人暴政」與皇位更替的連續混亂，高盧、萊茵、阿拉伯邊境同時吃緊，帝國在敘利亞的軍團與稅收監管大為鬆弛，帕米拉乘勢脫離羈絆：奧德納圖斯先以羅馬總督的身分取得軍權與關稅權，澤諾比婭接手後更把政令與鑄幣權一併握在手中，271年自行加奧古斯都號。近因是奧勒良的即位。270年奧勒良在安條克被澤諾比婭逐走，全羅馬都視之為奇恥；他在西西里與高盧重新部署，把多瑙河與萊茵的兵團調回東方。271年末埃及的費爾穆斯起兵並得到帕米拉暗中支持，迫使皇帝再分兵。272年春奧勒良率主力回到安條克，向北推進，先以伊邁一役打掉澤諾比婭的主力，再直搗其巢穴。經濟上的算盤同樣清楚：帕米拉的富庶來自橫穿沙漠的商隊關稅與絲綢、香料買賣，這筆收入與羅馬的東方財政直接相關，帝國不能容忍一個富而不臣的附庸。
causeEn: The reasons run from the distant to the immediate. In the long run, between AD 259 and 270 Rome passed through the so-called Thirty Tyrants and a run of imperial turnover, with the Gallic, Rhine and Arabian frontiers all failing at once; the empire's grip on the legions and the tax revenue of Syria slackened badly, and Palmyra used that opening. Odaenathus first took the military command and the customs as a Roman governor; Zenobia then added the civil command and the right to strike coin, and in 271 she took the title of Augustus for herself. The proximate cause was Aurelian's accession. In 270 he was driven out of Antioch by Zenobia, and the whole empire read it as a disgrace. He rebuilt his forces in Sicily and Gaul, calling troops back from the Danube and the Rhine, and at the end of 271 the revolt of Firmus in Egypt, secretly backed from Palmyra, forced him to divide again. In the spring of 272 Aurelian brought the main army back to Antioch, pushed north, broke Zenobia's field army at Immae, and went straight for her nest. The arithmetic of money was just as clear: the wealth of Palmyra came from caravan tolls and from silk and spice, a revenue stream tied directly to Rome's eastern finances, and the empire could not tolerate a rich and unobedient client.
impact: 這一役的後果分即時與長遠兩層。即時層面是帕米拉王國整個消失，敘利亞重新回到帝國的直接統治之下，澤諾比婭的頭像從此只出現在敵國的紀念幣上，瓦巴拉特的殘餘政權拖到275年才被徹底清除，埃及的費爾穆斯叛亂也在272至273年被平定，奧勒良於273年在羅馬舉行凱旋式，把自帕米拉掠得的財寶、織物與戰俘陳列在慶典上，羅馬的東方威信重新確立。長遠層面是邊疆體制的改變：戴克里先274年在廢墟上重建帕米拉，作為一座小型的帝國駐軍城與商路驛站，本地城邦時代的自治就此終結；此後帝國重心西移，商路逐漸轉向紅海與波斯灣，帕米拉在四世紀初已大為衰落，直到634年被阿拉伯軍攻破時只剩一座殘破小城，現存的柱廊街殘跡正是奧勒良焚城之後重建的痕跡。文化上，澤諾比婭成為西方與中東文學藝術中最著名的古代女性之一，十八、十九世紀的戲劇、小說與繪畫反覆演繹她作為「寧可自刎也不肯低頭的女王」的形象，她的名字還留在「澤諾比婭的財寶」這類故事裡。軍史上，此役是三世紀羅馬以皇帝親率的快速打擊奪回失地、隨即重建軍鎮的一個早期樣本。
impactEn: The consequences fall into an immediate and a long-term layer. Immediately, the Kingdom of Palmyra ceased to exist, Syria returned to direct imperial rule, Zenobia's portrait survived only on the coins of her conqueror, the rump of Vaballathus's regime lasted until 275 before it was cleared away, the revolt of Firmus in Egypt was suppressed in 272-273, and Aurelian's triumph at Rome in 273 displayed the treasure, the textiles and the prisoners taken from Palmyra, restoring the empire's eastern prestige. In the longer run the frontier system itself changed: Diocletian rebuilt Palmyra in 274 on the ruins as a small imperial garrison town and caravan station, and the autonomy of the old city-state era ended for good. As the empire's weight shifted west and the trade roads turned toward the Red Sea and the Persian Gulf, Palmyra declined sharply in the early fourth century; by 634, when the Arab armies took it, it was a battered small town, and the surviving colonnade in the ruins is the trace of the rebuilding that followed Aurelian's burning. Culturally, Zenobia became the most famous ancient woman in the literature and art of both the West and the Middle East; eighteenth- and nineteenth-century drama, fiction and painting returned to her again and again as the queen who would cut her own throat rather than bow, and her name survives in tales of the treasure of Zenobia. In military history the campaign is an early third-century model of a supreme commander striking fast to recover lost ground and then re-planting a garrison town behind his own line.
result: 結果是帕米拉失守、王國滅亡。272年春的伊邁之役中，羅軍騎兵正面擊潰帕米拉的裝甲重騎，澤諾比婭乘戰車逃離，羅軍攻佔她的營地與輜重；卡爾基斯一役後她丟下車隊單騎衝入沙漠，逃回帕米拉。奧勒良進軍城下，守軍在首領塞普蒂米烏斯主導下開門投降，澤諾比婭已在之前帶著財寶東走，於幼發拉底河一帶被羅軍巡騎擒獲，押往安條克，在272或273年間死於獄中或被處決。奧勒良入城後處死守軍首領及其子，下令短期的劫掠，最終拆毀城牆、焚燒城區，帕米拉的柱廊街只剩殘存柱身。瓦巴拉特於275年短暫復位，隔年即被奧勒良在羅馬處決。帝國收回了敘利亞的稅源與商路，戴克里先於274年在原址重建帕米拉駐軍城，澤諾比婭的政權從此只存在於錢幣與傳記之中。
resultEn: The result was the loss of Palmyra and the end of the kingdom. At Immae in the spring of 272 the Roman horse broke the Palmyrene cataphracts frontally, Zenobia fled in her chariot, and the Romans took her camp and baggage; after Chalcis she abandoned the baggage train, rode alone into the desert and reached Palmyra. When Aurelian came up under the walls, the garrison opened the gates under the leadership of Septimius, but Zenobia was already gone east with her treasure; she was picked up by Roman patrols near the Euphrates, taken to Antioch, and died in prison or was executed there in 272 or 273. Once inside, Aurelian executed the garrison commander and his son, allowed a short sack, and finally pulled down the walls and fired the city, leaving only the standing columns of the great street. Vaballathus was restored for a moment in 275 and executed by Aurelian in Rome the following year. The empire took back the taxes and the trade of Syria; Diocletian raised a garrison town of Palmyra on the same site in 274; and the polity of Zenobia survived only on coins and in the pages of historians.
